about: The Library's pictures (library.html's cards and sensor pages): each sensor of entries.json drawn by the Library's own 3D view (web/cad/library_view.js: Gen by Surface's sensor on the part, web/cad/onpart.js, and for a gripper its whole scene, web/cad/library_stage.js) at its Exploded and Assembled homes, with each file's bytes and SHA-256, the fit and build id it was shot from, the hashes of the figure's and the view's sources, the sensor's art (art/<id>.json.gz) and, for a gripper, its stage (its scene's hash and numbers).  A gripper is drawn whole (scenes/), the sensor finger's stack exploded and the near finger see-through in both views, its stack assembled.  Written by tools/browser/library_shots.py; tools/library_write.py writes entries.json's image and view from it.
